graph.title: Big Bling Wheelie
notes: The manual is low-resolution pictures only. The exact stacking positions of the lower plates (steps 1-5), the bracket/grille/headlight sub-assembly, and which black wedge goes where (steps 7-8) are best-guess readings; piece counts match the official parts list exactly (32 pieces).
Page 2 (combining with set 8655) uses parts from another set and is not modelled.
Four wheels each get a tyre; wheels are placed on the four pins of the two 2x2 pin bricks and spin freely.
Sticker sheet is attached to the curved wedge (b20) as an approximation of where stickers go.
The IDs b1-b24 follow build order approximately; wheel and tyre pieces are expanded from the 'wheel' repeat (4 copies).
Environment note: the claude.ai Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive MCP servers need authorization via claude.ai connector settings; they were not used here.
